speaker: Doctor
text:
The initial workup rules out substance intoxication, infection, and common metabolic or thyroid causes for your agitation. To determine if this is a primary psychiatric emergency or due to an undetected neurological issue, can you describe any recent head trauma, fever, or specific changes in your memory or vision?

REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain
REQUEST IMAGES: None needed at this stage.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the MRI and initial labs are normal, and we have ruled out substances, we need to clarify the nature of the behavioral changes. Have you had any recent severe stressors, exposure to hallucinogens, or a sudden onset of hearing voices or delusions?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. His wife adds that he has been increasingly withdrawn and intermittently depressed over the last 3 months. He was terminated from his job 4 weeks ago after he ceased attending work. Since his unemployment, he has been focused on creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia, Acute.

The clinical picture of a 26-year-old male with a 6-week history of bizarre agitation, persecutory delusions (NSA surveillance), and auditory hallucinations, combined with a 3-month prodrome of social withdrawal and depressed mood, is classic for schizophrenia. Given the acute onset and severity, immediate psychiatric stabilization is required.
